[[Bejunkan Pier]] is a dock area to the northwest of [[Kaineng Center]]. Most visitors or travelers from other continents set foot on [[Cantha]] here.

==Shrines==
;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]:
*[[Lyssa's Muse]]
**Northwestern end, by the water

==Quests available==
*[[Welcome to Cantha]] {{quest icon|primary}}

==NPCs==
These quests will affect the spawns in this area: 
*[[Intercepting the Am Fah]]
*[[Mhenlo's Request]]
*[[Sunspears in Cantha]]

===Allies===
*{{x}} 10 (20) [[Armian]]
*{{x}} 20 (20) [[Dockhand Quangnai]]

==Notes==
{{bug|Lyssa's Muse does not appear after [[Emote|kneeling]] at the [[statue of Lyssa]] and the resurrection shrine does not function. If a [[wipe]] occurs, your party will not be resurrected at the shrine.}}
* Complete exploration of this explorable area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title.

==Trivia==
*If one [[Shadow Step|shadow step]]s over the portal they can see that [[Kaineng Center]] has the Rifts seen in [[Kaineng Center (Sunspears in Cantha)]] permanently setup. 
*The name Bejunkan may derive its name from the Chinese style of boat, the [[w:Junk (ship)|Junk]].
*There is a dragon-wrapped lighthouse like the one in [[Port Kaimu]].
